criteria.description: States a clear hypothesis and a single primary metric (onboarding completion rate), not a vague 'see which is better'.
Computes (or shows how to compute) the required sample size from baseline, MDE, significance, and power, and translates it into a run duration at the given traffic.
Names a minimum detectable effect / smallest lift worth shipping as an explicit input, rather than leaving effect size undefined.
Includes guardrail metrics that must not regress (e.g. activation/quality of completion, downstream retention), not just the headline metric.
Pre-commits decision/stop rules and addresses not stopping early on a 'significant' peek (fixed duration or sequential method).
Specifies the randomization unit and/or flags classic traps (peeking, multiple comparisons, novelty, weekly seasonality).
